abstract: Best practices for @hellajs/store, the deeply reactive state package: store() converting plain objects into granular signals, nested stores, collection containers, and preserved functions; $snapshot copies, $update deep merges and draft mutators with structural diffing; per-key equals and middleware; readonly creation config; $subscribe single-key observation with unsubscribe discipline; $cleanup teardown scope; persistStore with localStorageAdaptor, sessionStorageAdaptor, and custom StoreAdaptors covering hydration, partialize, debounce, and dispose. Every rule is grounded in the package source and test suite.
